title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2610.37903v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Metis is a bet that better data, better training methods and new architectures can buy what a bigger parameter count cannot, at a fraction of the cost. Metis-1.6 is its latest step: two language models built from scratch by a single researcher, Praxis (2.94B parameters, 0.46B active per pass) and Logos (10.23B parameters, 1.18B active per pass). Both run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention mixture-of-experts stack twice for every token, so each token gets a second look. Each was trained on 1.02T tokens in total: 804.76B of pretraining, 18B of context extension to 131,072 tokens, and 200B of supervised fine-tuning. Metis-1.6 was never meant to challenge frontier models, and across 40 post-trained benchmarks it mostly does not: Logos averages 52.93, seventh of 17 models in its comparison set and within a point of Qwen3-4B. translated_title: 三思而行：Metis-1.6 技术报告
translated_abstract: Metis 是一场赌注：更好的数据、更好的训练方法和新的架构，能以极小的成本获得更大参数量也换不来的效果。Metis-1.6 是这一努力的最新一步：由一位研究者从零构建的两个语言模型——Praxis（29.4 亿参数，每次前向传播激活 4.6 亿参数）和 Logos（102.3 亿参数，每次前向传播激活 11.8 亿参数）。两者都对每个 token 运行两次 Mamba-2 与注意力机制的混合专家模型堆栈，因此每个 token 都能被“再看一遍”。每个模型总共使用了 1.02 万亿个 token 进行训练：其中 8047.6 亿用于预训练，180 亿用于将上下文扩展至 131,072 个 token，2000 亿用于有监督微调。Metis-1.6 从未打算挑战前沿模型，在 40 个后训练基准测试中，它大多确实没有做到：Logos 平均得分为 52.93，在其对比集合的 17 个模型中排名第七，与 Qwen3-4B 的差距在一分以内。但它是在大约只有公开数据的对比模型训练数据中位数十二分之一的条件下达到这一水平的，而且用了更少的……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: Metis-1.6 由一位研究者从零构建，采用对每个 token 运行两次混合 Mamba-2 与注意力专家模型堆栈的“三思而行”架构，仅用约对比模型中位数十二分之一的训练数据，就达到了接近 Qwen3-4B 的性能水平。
en_tdlr: Metis-1.6, two from-scratch sparse MoE language models built by a single researcher with a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention stack run twice per token, achieve performance within one point of Qwen3-4B using roughly a twelfth of the median training data of comparable models.
